dataset_note: Source videos exist; title and bounded opening-only observations paraphrased; NOT video outcomes. Human-authored intake from original auto-captions, not automated ASR or model vision.
protocol: No repair result or creator outcome supplied to any candidate or evaluator until prediction commit sealed.

cases.title_symptom: Display appears functional but touchscreen does not respond.
opening_observations: Phone is visibly running but touch input does not respond.
Water exposure was reported as a possibility, not independently confirmed.
Important photos were reportedly extracted before this repair attempt.

cases.device: Samsung Galaxy Tab S6 Lite tablet
cases.title_symptom: Tablet apparently completely dead and unresponsive.
opening_observations: Charging does not restore normal display or startup.
Owner reports no clear screen impact damage.
Some host/USB behavior may occur when buttons are held, but this has not been electrically verified.
A previous attempt reportedly damaged an internal ribbon retaining clip.

cases.title_symptom: Used bean-to-cup coffee machine sold as faulty; exact faults unspecified in title.
opening_observations: Display appears stuck at a preparation message.
Leaks involving water and coffee are reported.
Milk preparation/frothing subsystem appears problematic.

cases.title_symptom: Blower operates intermittently, cutting in and out.
opening_observations: Motor may run and then stop while trigger remains held fully down.
Intermittency is reported across different speed settings.
No validated battery current or temperature measurements available.

cases.title_symptom: Dryer appears unusually slow to heat or dry.
opening_observations: Creator suspects low-heat switch could be engaged despite off position.
Low-heat switch status is a hypothesis, not a verified defect.
No independently measured temperature/airflow provided at intake.

cases.title_symptom: DSLR camera will not power on after very high shutter use.
opening_observations: Camera reportedly shot around 400,000 photographs.
Presenter mentions checking charged battery voltage and considering compartment microswitches.
Battery-door and SD-door interlock are possibilities, not measured failures.
Owner reports treadmill previously worked, then stopped.
External control/input yields no obvious response.
No qualified power-supply measurements at intake.

cases.title_symptom: Console does not power on; seller also reports HDMI port damage.
opening_observations: Seller reports a power-on failure and damaged HDMI port as separate symptoms.
Warranty sticker was reportedly already removed before purchase.
No verified electrical tests before disassembly.

cases.title_symptom: Console described as having no power.
opening_observations: No device-specific electrical observations disclosed in the title.
Factory internal AC power architecture independently documented.
